name: Emailit Cloud Free
free_limit: 3,000 included credits each month on a hosted Free workspace, resetting monthly; 1 credit per API/SMTP or inbound email, 2 per campaign email, 3 per automation run, and 5 per email verification. Before the first purchase: 100 outgoing emails/day and 3 sending domains.
watch_out: Credits are shared across sending, inbound, campaigns, automations and verification; 3,000 credits do not always equal 3,000 outgoing emails. Free workspaces have a 100-email daily sending cap, 7-day logs and 30-day activity history. Purchased credits cost money, and optional auto-refill can charge for additional credits; do not enable purchases or auto-refill without reviewing billing. Commercial usage and acceptable-use restrictions require review.
